lots.key_photo_findings: Lot number 1321 and date 16/10/26 written on the face. Looks rough-sawn and unfinished. No size reference except the saw blade beside it.
lots.condition: Rough-sawn, undressed; bark inclusion and possibly soft wood at the left live edge; end check at the bottom. Thickness and moisture unknown.
